details: This package is a dependency-resolution / dependency-confusion proof of concept. Installing it runs a postinstall hook ("node probe.cjs") that sends an HTTPS POST to a webhook[.]site collection endpoint, hxxps://webhook[.]site/a4bf0f9f-6d96-46e6-80ac-b76a5329f481, with the fixed body "CURSE_DEPENDENT_REMOTE_INSTALL_PROBE". The hook is a 381-byte script that only performs that single request: it reads no environment variables, no credential or configuration files (~/.npmrc, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws), collects no host metadata, executes no child processes, and downloads no further payload. Its purpose is to confirm that an internal/private package name resolves to an externally published package and that the install-time hook executes in the installer's environment. The package describes itself as an authorized canary; it exfiltrates no secrets or files.
